title: Wednesday 25 November: AI trade cracks again
desc: Nvidia and Asian chip stocks slide as Anthropic falls below its IPO price; FDIC shows US bank unrealised losses up almost 50% to $486bn; markets price a December Fed hike ahead of today's PCE.

title: Tuesday 24 November: Huang returns, Irca deal hangs
desc: Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang sparks a 4.7% S&P rebound, UBS, Barclays, BNP and HSBC are left holding €1.2bn of Irca debt after CVC walks away, and Fed's Williams keeps a December hike in play.

title: Monday 23 November: Wall Street enters correction
desc: The S&P 500 falls into a correction as bank stocks post their worst week since April 2025, Anthropic's stock tests its IPO price, and HSBC refinances its AT1 at 7.625% while Asia rolls out market-support measures.

title: Friday 20 November: Banks hit death cross
desc: Wall Street sell-off drags US banks into a death cross, Anthropic closes 17% up after a faded debut, and the ECB keeps 2027 capital requirements broadly flat.

title: Thursday 19 November: Anthropic prices record IPO
desc: Anthropic prices the biggest IPO ever at 83 dollars, Fed hawks lift the dollar and yields, and Deutsche Bank faces a data-protection probe as UniCredit settles Commerzbank terms with Berlin.

title: Wednesday 18 November: Deutsche Bank files leak
desc: Leaked files hit Deutsche Bank shares, ING and SocGen sell data-centre loans as US chip curbs freeze a ByteDance-linked loan, and UBS looks set to lose its Swiss capital fight.

title: Tuesday 17 November: AI loan gets a price
desc: HSBC sells a slice of an Oracle-linked data-centre loan in the mid-80s, Brussels clears UniCredit-Commerzbank unconditionally, and US bank outages hit shares as the Nasdaq enters correction ahead of Nvidia and Anthropic.

title: Monday 16 November: New World tests its banks
desc: New World Development's deeply discounted rights issue and bank loan extension, record first halves and buybacks at the Japanese megabanks, and the Fed's warning on nearly one trillion dollars of bank exposure to the AI build-out.

title: Friday 13 November: Bonds Bite, Nvidia Shock
desc: Ten-year Treasury closes near 5.1% as cash bonds reopen; Jensen Huang quits Nvidia, jolting the AI-lending trade; Banco BPM opens talks with Credit Agricole on control-premium terms.

title: Thursday 12 November: ABN Amro beats, Treasuries reopen
desc: ABN AMRO beats with 940 million euros of profit and higher NII guidance, the US bond market reopens after a hot CPI print with a December Fed hike priced, and Credit Agricole's Banco BPM merger proposal plus the UniCredit-Commerzbank EU deadline drive Italian and German bank M&A.

title: Wednesday 11 November: Hot CPI, Fed hike talk
desc: Hot US inflation and Waller's half-point hint push Treasuries toward 5%, Commonwealth Bank posts a solid quarter with rising arrears, and Anthropic launches a record IPO roadshow.

title: Tuesday 10 November: UniCredit, Credit Agricole, Anthropic IPO
desc: UniCredit posts a record quarter and eyes Commerzbank control, Credit Agricole proposes merging its Italian unit into Banco BPM, and Anthropic's IPO roadshow nears as Hong Kong listings cool.

title: Monday 9 November: UniCredit, France, AI loans
desc: UniCredit's Commerzbank bid faces a Brussels deadline on 16 November, France's 2027 budget was rejected, and ING is shopping data-centre loans as AI debt reprices.

title: Friday 6 November: AI Rout Hits Banks
desc: Wall Street's worst day since April 2025 on an AI selloff spreads to Asia and AI-linked credit; the Bank of England hikes to 4 percent; Commerzbank posts a record nine months but trims interest income guidance.
